authority.source: repository/run truth outranks this staleable cache

active_product_bottleneck.observation: The >9.33 MB byte owner remains above the 1.25x Office create ceiling. Logical geometry is now exact: 12,787,462 B / 168 occurrences -> 4,748,362 B / 84 global objects, so 8,039,100 B (62.87%) is duplicate and almost entirely cross-container. Corrected v8 artifact 10795206744 shows cohort identity-first kernel 24.839 ms and fully charged direct-pointer bridge 28.281 ms versus ordinary full-native bridge 26.728 ms: deduplicating while still decoding all 168 occurrences does not itself save wall. The remaining leverage is earlier: admission proof already decodes all relevant occurrences for CRC/length, so it can establish logical identity; staging could then decode/materialize only 84 representatives instead of all 168.
active_product_bottleneck.next_discriminator: Run the cheapest gifted representative-only staging oracle: use exact logical identities from proof/oracle only to select one deterministic representative per global identity, then measure validation/materialization cost for those 84 representatives under the same charged boundary. This estimates the work actually deleted by proof-derived identity before any product integration.

primary_question.hypothesis: Adding logical SHA-256 to the already-required proof decode can make global logical identity available before staging; staging can then materialize only 84 representatives (4,748,362 B logical) instead of 168 occurrences (12,787,462 B), deleting duplicate decode/materialization rather than merely deduplicating its output.
primary_question.kill: One gifted representative-only staging oracle must show enough causal margin against the remaining ~12.484 ms create debt. If it does not, retire identity-first materialization without product integration. If it does, permit one bounded product attempt that derives logical identity during existing proof validation and stages representatives only.

frontier_candidates.question: How much wall is removed when staging decodes/materializes only one deterministic representative for each of the 84 proof-known global logical identities?
